settings.glossaryWorkingSet: Physical RAM pages currently resident for a process (includes shared DLLs).
settings.glossaryPrivateBytes: Virtual memory exclusively committed by a process across Physical RAM and Pagefile.
settings.glossaryStandby: Clean cached physical pages (P0–P7) counted inside Available RAM and repurposed immediately.
settings.glossaryModified: Dirty physical pages that must be written to disk/pagefile before reuse.
settings.glossaryNonpagedPool: Kernel & driver memory permanently pinned in physical RAM.
